The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
hashmap_free(link->bond_slaves);
link_detach_from_manager(link);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because `link->bond_slaves` is freed without ensuring that it is properly detached from its master link in the bond. If the link is part of a bond and is freed, the `bond_slaves` hashmap of its master link is not updated, leading to invalid memory access when the master link tries to access or modify the `bond_slaves` after the link has been freed.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (link->network) {
    if (link->network->bond &&
        link_get(link->manager, link->network->bond->ifindex, &master) >= 0)
        (void) hashmap_remove(master->bond_slaves, INT_TO_PTR(link->ifindex));
}
```
Reason:
These statements ensure that before the `bond_slaves` hashmap is freed, the link is properly removed from its master link's `bond_slaves`. This prevents invalid memory access by ensuring that the master link no longer references the freed link, thus maintaining the integrity of the bond management.
